cases.task: Choose the safe browser policy for an unexpected unnamed/default SSE message frame when the application protocol permits only named ready, event, page, terminal_error, and cursor_ahead frames.

required_facts.text: An unnamed/default SSE message is observable through EventSource's message listener and is outside the allowed application protocol.
Its browser-managed Last-Event-ID may advance even though no supported application handler accepted the frame.
The client must close and generation-fence the source without advancing its application cursor, both before and after ready.
